description: Get intraday price bars for ONE US stock or ETF, newest first: open, high, low, close, volume and trades, with VWAP on 1-minute bars. Use it for minute or hourly price history, intraday moves and backtests; GetStockPrices serves daily bars and GetLiveQuote the latest price. interval is 1min (default), 2min, 3min, 5min, 10min, 15min, 30min, 45min, 1hour, 2hour or 4hour, and a bar starts on a multiple of its interval counted from New York midnight. Defaults to the last 7 days (30 for hourly intervals); startDate and endDate set another window, back to 2016 where stored. session is regular (default, 09:30 through the closing auction) or extended (04:00 to 20:00 New York). adjustment is split (default, today's share basis) or raw (as traded). A period without trades has no bar. A cut answer names the endTime that continues it. Plus receives a bar 15 minutes after it ends, Pro as it forms; the Free plan is answered with an upgrade note. US tickers only.

adjustment.description: Price basis: split or raw (default: split)

endDate.description: Last New York trading date in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: today)

endTime.description: Return only bars that start before this RFC 3339 time; replaces endDate

maxResults.description: Maximum bars to return, newest first (default: 60, max: 500)

session.description: Trading hours: regular or extended (default: regular)

startDate.description: First New York trading date in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: 7 days before the end, 30 for hourly intervals)

ticker.description: US stock or ETF ticker, e.g. AAPL

name: GetIntradayStockPrices
title: Intraday Stock Prices
